get.summary: Get all purchase orders which match the specified search criteria.

parameters.name: lastReceiveTimeFrom
parameters.description: Filter for purchase orders where goods have been received after this time.

parameters.name: lastReceiveTimeTo
parameters.description: Filter for purchase orders where goods have been received before this time.

parameters.name: purchaseOrderStatusFrom
parameters.description: Filter for purchase orders whose order status is greater than or equal to this.

parameters.name: purchaseOrderStatusTo
parameters.description: Filter for purchase orders whose order status is less than or equal to this.

parameters.name: onlyPurchaseOrdersWithOrderLinesToReport
parameters.description: Filter for purchase orders where at least one line has ReportedNumberOfItems != ReceivedNumberOfItems.

parameters.name: purchaseOrderIdFrom
parameters.description: Only return purchase orders whose purchase order ID is greater than or equal to this.

parameters.name: maxPurchaseOrdersToGet
parameters.description: The maximum number of purchase orders to return.

parameters.name: purchaseOrderStatusChangedTimeFrom
parameters.description: Only return purchase orders whose status has changed after this time.

parameters.name: articleNumbers
parameters.description: Filter for purchase orders which contains at least one of these article numbers.

parameters.name: inDateFrom
parameters.description: Filter for purchase orders where the expected indate is after this date.

parameters.name: inDateTo
parameters.description: Filter for purchase orders where the expected indate is before this date.

parameters.name: purchaseOrderTypeCode
parameters.description: Filter for purchase orders with the specified purchase order type code.

parameters.name: purchaseOrderHeadOrLinesChangedTimeFrom
parameters.description: Filter for purchase orders where either the header or lines have been changed after this time.

parameters.name: includePurchaseOrderPalletItems
parameters.description: Advanced option. If true, then we will return the field advanced.purchaseOrderPalletItems.
